data.title: Crusader for crime victims faces money-laundering charges
data.description: Cybercrime police arrested crime victims’ rights activist Atchariya Ruengrattanapong outside a boxing stadium in Samut Sakhon on Saturday on charges including money laundering.

data.title: Two Japanese rescued after being forced into border scam work
data.description: Thai police have rescued two Japanese men who said they were forced to travel to Thailand to work for a scam gang across the border in Myanmar, where they were made to defraud elderly people in Japan.

data.title: Local lessons for the People’s Party
data.description: The defeat of the People’s Party in the Sept 20 election for chairman of the Nonthaburi Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) highlights a familiar but noteworthy question for the main opposition: how effectively can its strong national popularity be translated into votes in local contests?

data.title: Oily film in Prachin Buri floodwaters investigated
data.description: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has ordered the Pollution Control Department (PCD) to urgently investigate an iridescent film resembling used lubricating oil found in floodwaters in Prachin Buri.

data.title: Local lessons for the PP
data.description: The People's Party's (PP) defeat in the Sept 20 election for chairman of the Nonthaburi Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) highlights a familiar but noteworthy question for the main opposition: how effectively can its strong national popularity be translated into votes in local contests?

data.title: PCD probes oily film in Prachin Buri floodwaters
data.description: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has ordered the Pollution Control Department (PCD) to urgently investigate an iridescent film resembling used lubricating oil found in floodwaters in Prachin Buri.

data.title: Online system links flood victims to free repairs
data.description: The government has launched the "Traffy Fondue Repair, Rebuild, Fight Floods" system to connect flood-affected residents with agencies providing free repairs to homes, electrical systems, appliances and vehicles as waters recede.

data.title: Single checkpoint plan gains ground
data.description: Thailand and Laos have discussed introducing a single inspection checkpoint for customs and immigration procedures to streamline cross-border trade and strengthen regional connectivity.

data.title: MP Suchada under House scrutiny
data.description: Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap, 33, has come under parliamentary scrutiny following allegations involving her husband and cryptocurrency transactions.

data.title: Two hurt in petrol station blast
data.description: Narathiwat: A bomb exploded at a PT petrol station in Tak Bai district on Thursday night, damaging fuel pumps and the station building and injuring two employees, authorities said.

data.title: Alarm as tobacco firms target Asean
data.description: Public health advocates have sounded the alarm over aggressive interference by multinational tobacco companies in Southeast Asia, warning that without stronger regional safeguards, millions of lives remain at risk.

data.title: Chinese suspect held over drug trafficking network
data.description: A Chinese man suspected of helping a transnational drug trafficking network ship drugs from Thailand to China has been arrested in Bangkok.

data.title: More rain coming from Oct 11-14
data.description: The government has warned residents in the Central Plains and areas along the Chao Phraya River to prepare for heavy rain expected on Oct 11-14 as authorities continue flood relief and water-management operations.

data.title: New Supreme Court chief pledges fairer access to justice
data.description: Weerapong Sudawong, the 52nd president of the Supreme Court, has pledged to uphold the rule of law, widen access to justice and keep the judicial process from being distorted as he set out policies for fiscal 2027.

data.title: City steps up drainage before rains
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is accelerating efforts to drain floodwater in the Saphan Sung and Lat Krabang areas ahead of rainfall forecast for Oct 5-8.

data.title: Bhumjaithai MP faces questions over finances
data.description: People’s Party MP Rangsiman Rome will invite Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband to clarify cryptocurrency and financial transactions on Oct 7.

data.title: Bhumjaithai seeks to reform Thai PBS funding
data.description: The Bhumjaithai Party has proposed overhauling the way Thai Public Broadcasting Service (Thai PBS) is funded by scrapping its earmarked share of alcohol and tobacco taxes, worth up to 2 billion baht a year, and making annual government budget allocations its main source of funding.

data.title: Baggage claims to be moved to new location, THAI compensation pledged
data.description: Thai Airways International (THAI) will move baggage collection to a new place on Saturday as the Ministry of Transport has pledged financial compensation for flyers affected by flight and baggage chaos after flooding paralysed the airline.

data.title: Two suspects deny premeditated murder of Russian siblings
data.description: CHON BURI - The two men accused of robbing, raping and killing two Russian siblings in Chonburi in July have pleaded guilty to most of the charges against them but denied the claim of premeditated murder at Pattaya Provincial Court on Friday.
